calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, take the negative three-session rolling mean of the overnight gap, using today's open relative to the prior completed close. Higher values indicate accumulated negative overnight gaps and predict short-horizon reversal. Signal is evaluated against next-session return.

validation.regime_notes: Positive across 2020-2022 (IC 0.035434, ICIR 0.123561) and 2023-2024 (IC 0.029685, ICIR 0.087211), but weakened in 2025-2026 (IC 0.015651, ICIR 0.050957). Interpret recent drift conservatively.
validation.methodology: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC; only dates with at least 8 valid instruments; information available through prior completed session for the forecast.
